objective: Independent prediction of static inharmonic partial ratios; not unique physical string identity or commercial algorithm equivalence.

stationary_line.meaning: Frequency adequate under the declared finite stationary damped-sinusoid models; not absolute absence of AM.
stationary_line.can_enter_family_fit: Only with qualified interval and independently validated family/index/window/repeat obligations.

resolved_components.meaning: Individually resolved frequencies, not automatic physical string assignments.

conditional_am_carrier.meaning: Carrier parameter conditional on the registered AM model; a coherent triplet may produce identical PCM.

raw_power_peak.meaning: Candidate from stereo power spectrum; not a certified stationary line, carrier or centre string.

frequency_interval.rule: interval contains reported positive frequency and worst half-width <= max(0.005, f*(2**(0.05/1200)-1)); actual truth coverage separately checked by independent qualification.

ppa_candidate_band.meaning: Only lower the existing search floor when low-note coverage requires it; do not narrow higher-note bands or treat a spectral candidate as a certified observation.

family_admission.partial_numbering: One-based; correct assignment required, not just a low fit residual.
family_admission.holdout: Reidentify from observed PCM; no truth/production-B-guided selection.
family_admission.structural_observation_policy: PPA and reference_quality share observation_blocks_family: resolved_components, or ambiguous with coherent_structure_outside_component_search_bounds / multiple_component_alternative_unresolved, rejects the whole family even for excluded numbers. Ordinary information abstention alone does not establish a mixture; all retained lines still require qualified observations.

comparison.observable: Matching qualified stationary partial numbers on both producers, not strongest raw peaks or an AM carrier substituted for one side.
comparison.base: Lowest common admissible partial; excluded from error samples.
comparison.family_guard: Both complete families must pass reference_quality before applying the candidate mask. Any observed mixed or explicit structural-conflict candidate, including excluded numbers and either window, rejects its whole family; a clean retained subset cannot erase recorded structural evidence.
comparison.topology_basis: Frozen built-in Piano88KeyTable.h stringCount design and PianoSynthVoice::startNote: MIDI21..35 is monochord; no recovery of differentiated bichord/trichord components.
comparison.time_coordinate: NoteOn-relative windows; each producer requires an independently bound MIDI-origin sample, not error-minimizing alignment.

inconclusive_policy: Retain every registered unit and reason; weak/mixed/time-varying/unqualified data are not zero error, a passing subset, or permission to replace a unit.

limits.AM_child_study: study_qualified only in its finite preregistered domain
